body:
Hello, little one!

The pond in the meadow is full of life this week. Would you like to look in my dipping net with me?

I'll be waiting by the pond, past the young apple trees.
summary: Look at the pond creatures with Mrs. Ruth.
done: Every creature is back home, and the lambs are fed. Thank you!

tasks.text: Look at the pond creatures with Mrs. Ruth
Feed the lambs at the sheepfold
